name: VeriqoMesh Network
description: VeriqoMesh is a programmable trust layer for human and AI-assisted commerce on Monad. Initiators define agreements, counterparties authorize them, independent verifiers attest outcomes, and Monad smart contracts enforce escrow and settlement.

securityPrinciples.corePrinciple: AI assists. Humans authorize. Verifiers verify. Blockchain enforces.
securityPrinciples.aiAuthority: Zero financial execution authority. AI cannot release escrow, refund capital, or settle disputes without human wallet cryptographic authorization.
securityPrinciples.onchainCommitments: Deterministic canonical terms hashing with immutable smart contract state transitions on Monad Metropolis Testnet.
